notes: Concord Mk2 (two layers): Mk1 plus a second ring counter-rotating inside the first, a thin outer ring round the dome with blue nodes, two layer pips, corner lamps and registry stencil. On loop (8): two emitter rings and the dome petals turning against each other, arcs crawling between the pylons, pylons lighting N, E, S, W, the core breathing. hit (3): flare and ripple. recharge (4): rings spinning up. Damaged: dome cracked with a dark chip, west pylon dead, a casing flap hangs off the lower-right corner, the outer ring has a gap. Disabled: dome shattered, west pylon smashed, casing split corner to corner.
